relations.why: Both count parameters of TypeScript and JavaScript functions and share the fn.params dimension: CC-FN-002 denies above 3 and MP-PARAMS-001 warns above 4, so the warning only repeats a stricter denial.
relations.settle: Pick the adopted limit with "resolve": {"fn.params": {"use": "clean-code/CC-FN-002"}} or the mattpocock alias.

source.work: Matt Pocock — Skills For Real Engineers
source.locator: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills/blob/6fd947921b935b7e1e69293a200400f0fdd5c15f/skills/engineering/codebase-design/SKILL.md — Designing for testability / Small surface area
source.paraphrase: Reduce the inputs a caller must understand when choosing a module interface.

invariants.why: A wide function input surface makes calling and testing the function harder. Four inputs is this pack's starting calibration, not an upstream numeric rule or a measure of module depth.
invariants.fixHint: Group inputs that form a genuine domain concept, or simplify the function's responsibility.
invariants.avoid: This metric counts effective inputs, including destructuring, inline object leaves and tuple-rest slots. Named aggregate types are opaque. It applies to parsed functions/methods, including internal helpers; it does not identify public seams or measure leverage, semantic depth, method count, ordering constraints or error modes. Tune max and paths; do not pad an implementation or disguise unrelated inputs in an options bag.

source.locator: Enums Considered Harmful / Prefer as const and union types over TypeScript enums
source.paraphrase: Avoid TypeScript enums in application code; use union types or as-const objects that do not emit runtime IIFEs or introduce nominal compatibility surprises.

invariants.why: TypeScript enums emit runtime objects, create reverse-mapping pitfalls for numeric enums, and require importing the enum symbol at every call site instead of passing plain literal values.
invariants.fixHint: Replace the enum with a literal union (`type Status = 'pending' | 'paid'`) or an `as const` object (`const Status = { Pending: 'pending' } as const`).
invariants.avoid: Both standard `enum` and `const enum` declarations are flagged as advisory warnings. Ambient `declare enum` declarations describing external packages are ignored.
